render.implementation: (1) THE EXTRACTION, two VLM passes reconciled: a 16-frame @2fps whole-clip pass (eventscript.json: the roster of 5, per-frame positions, timed events) + a 17-frame @8fps shot-window pass (finescript.json: the shot release 6.35s, the goal cross 6.75s, the GK dive 6.375s toward the near post, the ball-flight points) → the canonical event-stream.json (5 players' PCHIP keyframe tracks + the ball's 9 typed segments + the caption timeline). (2) THE RENDER, deterministic (render_board.py, OpenCV, 1280x720, 65 frames @8fps): the pass @0.4-1.0s, the pass into space @3.4-4.1s, the carry, the shot @6.35s with trail, the GK dive shape @6.375s, the net ripple, the GOAL banner + the scoreboard flip 0-0→1-0 AT 6.75s (the measured source timing), phase captions synced to the true event times + ffmpeg x264. (3) THE CARRY: the 3d/anime/original copied BYTE-IDENTICAL from reprep4 (the judgment-5 MVP-accepted versions), sha256-verified at staging.

designGate.method: the design gate by MEASUREMENT before freezing, extended with the NEW per-event fidelity gate — the direct test of the judgment-5 refusal ground (the event script itself): original frame vs board frame at IDENTICAL timestamps
designGate.perEventFidelity: 4/4 FAITHFUL — pairs at t=0.75 / 3.6 / 6.5 / 7.25 (the same_event_phase, ball_state_consistent, gk_state_consistent, players_involved_consistent checks all true at every pair); the verbatim JSON in the out dir's fidelity.json
designGate.boardCheck: 6/6 ALL-YES (A flat top-down 2D pitch; B colored numbered markers; C markers + ball changing positions; D goal with net on the right + goalkeeper marker; E ball inside the net with GOAL overlay in the last frame; F broadcast-style 2D tactical board)
